title: Modeling and shading realistic eyes in Blender

queue.claim: Visible iris / corneal diameter (HVID, white-to-white) is ~11.7-11.8 mm with SD ~0.5-0.8 mm across adults; used as the metric scale prior (mu 11.8, sigma 0.6) and for depth Z = f_px * 11.8 / HVID_px.
queue.query: horizontal visible iris diameter white-to-white mean standard deviation adults population study

queue.claim: Anterior chamber depth (epithelium to lens) is about 2.8-3.6 mm (mean about 3.1 mm). The iris is near-planar or slightly convex forward, not concave. The entrance pupil is about 13% larger and about 0.5 mm anterior to the real pupil.
queue.query: anterior chamber depth normal adults mean mm iris configuration convex anterior segment OCT entrance pupil magnification

queue.claim: The centre of eye rotation is about 13-14 mm behind the corneal apex (default 13.3 mm), and angle kappa/alpha is about +3 to +6 degrees (the optical axis sits temporal to the visual axis).
queue.query: centre of rotation of the eye distance behind cornea mm angle kappa normal values degrees

queue.claim: Hertel exophthalmometry normal values: the corneal apex sits about 12-20 mm (typically 15-17 mm) anterior to the lateral orbital rim, with left-right difference of 2 mm or less and variation by ethnicity.
queue.query: Hertel exophthalmometry normal values adults by ethnicity mean mm
